content: An AI has taken control of the world’s machines. Choose from three tanks, each with a distinct combat style, and fight to reclaim the world. Spin the turret, swing your cannon barrel, and ram straight through enemy ranks. Chain drifts, attacks, and unique abilities to tear through enemy hordes. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5186030/SLAM_TANK/ Developer: Next Stage
